confidence_notes: FX is the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026, found via search. I made one search for Munnar food prices. It returned only rough traveler-budget figures (meals about $2-11, coffee about $1) and no beer, cocktail or wine prices. Beer, cocktail and wine are estimates based on typical Kerala restaurant and resort pricing and the relationship to beer. Alcohol is limited and pricey in Kerala because of state taxes. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Hostel supply in Munnar is small, and the 1-star and 3-star prices vary seasonally.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kerala and South India hill-station tourist pricing, comparable to Ooty or Kochi tourist areas, with a premium for resorts and beer.
